reference.patch: The original instruction requested "news images of stocks with rising prices", but groundTruth covered the entire Reuters card for "SoftBank to invest $2 billion in Intel", accepting points on the source name, headline, and stock symbols as well as the image. The card includes SFTBF +1.34% alongside INTC -3.66%; the positive SFTBF change supplies the rising-stock clue even though another stock on the same card is falling. Rewrote instruction.en and instruction.zh to request the single thumbnail of the news story that includes a stock with a rising price. Changed groundTruth from [694.0, 1022.0, 1067.0, 49.0] to [770.0, 1004.0, 997.0, 776.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, restricting accepted points to the SoftBank thumbnail.
